## Status: fixed 2026-09-08 in `13a2560` (#18), released in ccx > v0.57.0

Kept because the diagnostic trap below is still true and still costs an
afternoon, and because the shape of the bug is worth recognising again.

## What went wrong

`ccx vcs ship`'s graphite lane derived every `base`, `baseSha`, and PR-create
title range from the **local** trunk branch. With the local trunk behind the
remote, a branch whose commits were already upstream still measured as having
real commits, so `gtSubmitPlan` planned it as a `SubmitCreate` and Graphite
refused the whole request with an HTTP 400.

Observed 2026-09-04 in `Forge-AI/monorepo`: local `dev` 9 commits behind
`origin/dev`; `worktree-wf_80dcbd59-34c-3` (0 commits above `origin/dev`, no PR,
not on origin) was gt's recorded parent of `yasyf/iris-edge-token` and got
planned as a PR create.

`df3f2be`'s per-branch submit loop did **not** save it: the loop returns on the
first refusal, so a junk branch at the bottom of the chain meant the branch
actually being shipped never got its PR.

## The two compounding causes, both now closed

1. **Harness worktree branches got adopted into the stack.** `shipPreflightGT`'s
   `gt track -f` adopts onto the most recent tracked ancestor, and
   `~/.claude/worktrees` branches named `worktree-wf_*` / `worktree-agent-*` were
   eligible. That repo tracked 9 of them, one already pushed to origin.
   *Now:* the adopt is refused when the resolved parent is contained in the
   remote trunk, naming `--parent <branch>` and `ccx vcs prune`.
2. **`ccx vcs prune` orphaned children.** `pruneApply` forgot a gt row without
   touching its children, so pruning an interior parent left a child pointing at
   a branch that no longer existed and `gtDownstack` failed on that whole stack.
   *Now:* prune reparents onto the first surviving ancestor with trunk as the
   floor, and `Forget` strikes each branch from its parent's `children` too.

## The diagnostic trap — still true

Since `d595811` (v0.52.0) ship's gt lane calls Graphite's HTTP API directly
rather than shelling `gt submit`, so **its requests appear nowhere in
`~/.local/share/graphite/debug/`**. A failed ship leaves no trace in gt's debug
corpus. Anything found there during a ship incident is a human's or another
agent's own `gt` invocation, distinguishable by flag order: ccx builds
`--no-interactive` before `--no-edit` and always passes `--no-ai`.

## Checking a stack for this shape

    ccx vcs info                      # the downstack ccx would actually submit
    sqlite3 .git/.graphite_metadata.db \
      "select branch_name, parent_branch_name, children from branch_metadata;"
    git rev-list --count origin/<trunk>..<branch>   # 0 means nothing to submit

The monorepo was repaired on 2026-09-08: 37 merged branches deleted, 11 rows
forgotten, `yasyf/iris-edge-token` reparented onto `dev`. Three diverged
`worktree-*` rows survive by design — they carry real commits and parent nothing.
